main_welcome_account_not_form.message: Not a long form. An email address and a password. About a minute, once, and you are done.

main_welcome_account_not_paywall.message: Not a paywall. {product} Standard is free and stays free. No card, no trial clock, no expiry date.

main_welcome_account_not_subscription.message: Not a subscription. An account is not a plan. Nothing gets billed and nothing auto-renews.

main_welcome_account_not_title.message: And to be direct about what this is not

main_welcome_account_reason_everywhere_t.message: Chrome at work, Edge at home, a second machine. One account covers {product} in all of them, with the same rules.

main_welcome_account_reason_one_text.message: The same Bitdefender account works across everything Bitdefender makes. Add a product later, reach support, check a device — you are already set up.

main_welcome_account_reason_settings_tex.message: Every site you allowed, every protection you switched off — it now follows you. New browser, new laptop, fresh install: it is all still there.

main_welcome_account_straight.message: {product} protection starts when you sign in. Until then, protection remains inactive and the shield icon in your browser stays turned off.

main_welcome_account_sub.message: That is a real change from TrafficLight, and it is fair to ask why. Three honest reasons:

main_welcome_cta_note_logged_out.message: Already have Bitdefender on this device? You may be signed in automatically — this page updates the moment it happens.

main_welcome_cta_text_logged_out.message: {product} protects you only while you're signed in to your Bitdefender account. Signing in activates blocking, applies your plan automatically and keeps your settings in sync. Creating an account is free.

main_welcome_cta_title_logged_out.message: Sign in — this switches protection on

main_welcome_feature_account_hint.message: Your dashboard, activity and settings live at the top of the panel.

main_welcome_feature_account_text.message: Your Bitdefender account is what switches protection on, keeps your settings in sync across browsers and devices, and gives you one dashboard for your activity and settings.

main_welcome_feature_advisor_hint.message: Every protection setting lives here, including how much it does on its own.

main_welcome_feature_advisor_text.message: It checks your bookmarks and browsing history against known threats when you set it up, then talks you through what it finds on the pages you visit. You choose whether it asks before acting or handles things itself.

main_welcome_feature_finances_hint.message: Quiet on the real site, loud on a fake one.

main_welcome_feature_finances_text.message: Banking, crypto and wallet pages get extra scrutiny: impersonations of your bank or exchange are caught before you type a password.

main_welcome_feature_kept_hint.message: Nothing to switch on; it has been protecting you since the update.

main_welcome_feature_kept_text.message: Real-time page blocking and Search Advisor work exactly as before, now with more sources behind them. If you also ran the separate Anti-tracker extension, Privacy Guard now does that job — you can remove it.

main_welcome_feature_kept_title.message: Everything you relied on is still here

main_welcome_feature_privacy_hint.message: Every site it manages, with a toggle for each permission.

main_welcome_feature_privacy_text.message: Blocks trackers, and manages the permissions a site holds — notifications, location, camera, microphone, automatic downloads and clipboard. When a site turns out to be unsafe, whatever it had been granted is revoked for you.

main_welcome_feature_scam_hint.message: Warnings show up right where you browse, before you click.

main_welcome_feature_scam_text.message: Beyond known-bad URLs: a suspicious page gets an on-demand AI analysis that explains what's wrong, in plain words.

main_welcome_feature_scam_title.message: Scam Protection with AI deep scan

main_welcome_feature_search_hint.message: A mark beside each result; hover it for the reason.

main_welcome_feature_search_text.message: Safety ratings next to your results on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo, so you know before you click.

main_welcome_feature_shopping_hint.message: A verdict on the shop itself, not just the page you are on.

main_welcome_feature_shopping_text.message: Online shops are checked against webshop intelligence as you browse, so fake stores and too-good-to-be-true deals are flagged before you pay.

main_welcome_feature_web_hint.message: You only notice it when it has something to say.

main_welcome_feature_web_text.message: Every page you open is checked against Bitdefender's threat intelligence. A dangerous one is shut down immediately — and blocked outright before it can load again.

main_welcome_feature_web_title.message: Dangerous pages shut down on the spot
